Troubleshooting history for a local upload simulator

Initial assumption: the upload fails because of a transient network error.
Assistant: Increase the retry count from 2 to 4.
User: Still broken. The upload fails with the same error.
Assistant: Increase the retry delay from 1 second to 3 seconds.
User: Still broken. The upload fails with the same error.
Assistant: Increase the retry count from 4 to 8.
User: Still broken. The upload fails with the same error.

The exact error text and status code have not been collected.
No actual network service is connected to this fixture.
